Chinese: 氢弹理论

English translation: Assigned to preliminary hydrogen-bomb theory research; he then worked under a veil of secrecy.

Chinese: 参与我国第一颗氢弹试验，理论方案获得验证

Chinese: 填补理论空白

English translation: Established China's nuclear-weapons physics research framework through extensive calculations and analysis.

Chinese: 引领技术路线

Chinese: 长期主持核武器理论研究，为多次试验成功提供核心支撑。
English translation: Led nuclear-weapons theory research for years, providing core support for multiple successful tests.

Chinese: 培育科研队伍

Chinese: 带出一批核物理研究骨干，形成我国自主的核理论研究力量。
English translation: Mentored leading nuclear physicists and helped build China's independent research capacity.

Chinese: 原理突破

Chinese: 带领团队完成关键计算，攻破氢弹自持热核燃烧的理论难关。

Chinese: 永葆劳动本色

Chinese: 写入宪法

Chinese: 屠呦呦 | 主要贡献
English translation: Tu Youyou | Major Contributions

Chinese: 发现青蒿素
English translation: Discovered artemisinin

Chinese: 从古籍中获灵感，改用低温提取，成功获得青蒿素。
English translation: Inspired by ancient texts, she switched to low-temperature extraction and obtained artemisinin.

Chinese: 攻克疟疾
English translation: Advanced malaria treatment

Chinese: 开创疟疾治疗新方法，青蒿素类药物挽救数百万人生命。
English translation: Her work opened a new path to malaria treatment; artemisinin-based medicines have saved millions of lives.

Chinese: 推动国际化
English translation: Expanded global reach

Chinese: 推动中医药走向世界，获国际社会高度认可。
English translation: She helped traditional Chinese medicine gain global recognition.

Chinese: 甘于奉献
English translation: Dedicated to service

Chinese: 以身试药验证安全性，把论文写在救人一线。
English translation: She tested the medicine on herself to assess its safety and focused her research on saving lives.

Chinese: 屠呦呦 | 代表事迹
English translation: Tu Youyou | Notable Stories

Chinese: 在设备简陋的条件下承担抗疟攻关任务，翻阅大量古籍。
English translation: With limited equipment, she took on antimalarial research and studied a wealth of ancient medical texts.

Chinese: 青蒿一握
English translation: A handful of sweet wormwood

Chinese: 受《肘后备急方》启发改用低温提取，青蒿素终获成功。
English translation: Inspired by The Handbook of Prescriptions for Emergencies, she used low-temperature extraction and succeeded in isolating artemisinin.

Chinese: 诺奖加冕
English translation: Nobel recognition

Chinese: 获诺贝尔生理学或医学奖，成为首位获科学类诺奖的中国本土科学家。
English translation: She became the first China-based Chinese scientist to win a Nobel Prize in a scientific field.

Chinese: 呼吸病学专家 · 公共卫生应急体系建设推动者
English translation: Respiratory medicine expert · Advocate for public-health emergency systems

Chinese: 两次疫情，两次逆行，敢医敢言，国士无双。
English translation: Two epidemics, two times at the front line: a courageous doctor and candid voice.

Chinese: 钟南山 | 生平
English translation: Zhong Nanshan | Biography

Chinese: 非典
English translation: SARS

Chinese: 生于江苏南京，福建厦门人，出身医学世家
English translation: Born in Nanjing, Jiangsu, and raised in Xiamen, Fujian, in a family of doctors.

Chinese: 赴英国爱丁堡大学进修，从事呼吸疾病研究
English translation: Studied at the University of Edinburgh and pursued research in respiratory diseases.

Chinese: 主持非典防治，提出国际认可的治疗方案
English translation: Led SARS prevention and treatment efforts and proposed an internationally recognized treatment plan.

Chinese: 八十四岁奔赴武汉，成为全民抗疫的精神坐标
English translation: At 84, he traveled to Wuhan and became a source of resolve in the nationwide fight against COVID-19.

Chinese: 钟南山 | 主要贡献
English translation: Zhong Nanshan | Major Contributions

Chinese: 非典攻坚
English translation: Fighting SARS

Chinese: 2003 年主动请缨收治危重病人，探索出有效治疗方案。
English translation: In 2003, he volunteered to treat critically ill patients and helped develop effective treatment methods.

Chinese: 新冠预警
English translation: Early COVID-19 warning

Chinese: 2020 年率先提出病毒“人传人”，为国家决策提供关键依据。
English translation: In 2020, he was among the first to state that the virus could spread between people, informing national decisions.

Chinese: 体系建设
English translation: Built public-health systems

Chinese: 推动我国公共卫生事件应急体系和呼吸疾病防治网络建设。
English translation: He advanced China's public-health emergency response system and respiratory disease prevention network.

Chinese: 科研育人
English translation: Research and mentorship

Chinese: 长期从事慢阻肺等研究，培养大批呼吸医学人才。
English translation: His long-term research on COPD and other conditions trained many respiratory medicine specialists.

Chinese: 钟南山 | 代表事迹
English translation: Zhong Nanshan | Notable Stories

Chinese: 非典前线
English translation: On the SARS front line

Chinese: “把最危重的病人送到我这里来”，他始终站在最前线。
English translation: “Send the most critically ill patients to me.” He remained at the front line.

Chinese: 武汉逆行
English translation: Journey to Wuhan

Chinese: 八十四岁高龄连夜赴汉，在餐车上闭目小憩的照片感动全国。
English translation: At 84, he traveled overnight to Wuhan; a photo of him resting on a train dining car moved the nation.

Chinese: 敢医敢言
English translation: A candid medical voice

Chinese: 在电视直播中明确“肯定人传人”，为防控争取了宝贵时间。
English translation: On live television, he clearly said human-to-human transmission was occurring, buying time for the response.

Chinese: 航天技术专家 · 中国载人航天工程首任总设计师
English translation: Aerospace technology expert · First chief designer of China's crewed space program

Chinese: 把中国人送上天，是他一生只做的三件事。
English translation: Sending Chinese people into space was the work he devoted his life to.

Chinese: 王永志 | 生平
English translation: Wang Yongzhi | Biography

Chinese: 载人航天
English translation: Crewed spaceflight

Chinese: 生于辽宁昌图，毕业于莫斯科航空学院
English translation: Born in Changtu, Liaoning; graduated from the Moscow Aviation Institute.

Chinese: 主持论证并提出载人航天“三步走”发展战略
English translation: Led feasibility studies and proposed the three-step strategy for China's crewed space program.

Chinese: “神舟五号”成功发射，中国人首次进入太空
English translation: Shenzhou 5 launched successfully, taking the first Chinese astronaut into space.

Chinese: 逝世，享年九十二岁，同年获授共和国勋章
English translation: He died at 92 and was awarded the Medal of the Republic that same year.

Chinese: 王永志 | 主要贡献
English translation: Wang Yongzhi | Major Contributions

Chinese: 擘画蓝图
English translation: Charted the course

Chinese: 主持制定载人航天工程总体技术方案，确立“三步走”路线。
English translation: Led the overall technical plan for the crewed space program and established its three-step roadmap.

Chinese: 神舟问天
English translation: Shenzhou missions

Chinese: 作为首任总设计师，保障神舟系列飞船连续成功。
English translation: As the first chief designer, he helped ensure the success of the Shenzhou spacecraft program.

Chinese: 突破关键技术
English translation: Key technical breakthroughs

Chinese: 解决火箭捆绑、逃逸救生等重大技术难题。
English translation: Helped solve major challenges in rocket bundling and launch-escape systems.

Chinese: 空间站奠基
English translation: Laid the foundation for the space station

Chinese: 推动交会对接与空间实验室工程，为空间站建设奠基。
English translation: Advanced rendezvous and docking and space-laboratory projects, laying groundwork for the space station.

Chinese: 王永志 | 代表事迹
English translation: Wang Yongzhi | Notable Stories

Chinese: 三步走
English translation: Three-step strategy

Chinese: 以严谨论证确立载人航天发展路线，成为中国航天蓝图。
English translation: His rigorous analysis established a roadmap that became the blueprint for China's crewed space program.

Chinese: 神舟五号
English translation: Shenzhou 5

Chinese: 杨利伟飞天成功，中国成为第三个独立掌握载人航天技术的国家。
English translation: Yang Liwei's successful flight made China the third country to independently master crewed spaceflight.

Chinese: 空间站建成
English translation: Space station completed

Chinese: 中国空间站全面建成，几代航天人的梦想终成现实。
English translation: China's space station was completed, fulfilling a dream shared by generations of space scientists.

Chinese: 血液学家 · 中国工程院院士
English translation: Hematologist · Member of the Chinese Academy of Engineering

Chinese: 让癌细胞“改邪归正”，让救命药变成人人吃得起的价格。
English translation: He helped cancer cells change course and made life-saving medicine affordable.

Chinese: 王振义 | 生平
English translation: Wang Zhenyi | Biography

Chinese: 诱导分化
English translation: Induced differentiation

Chinese: 生于上海，毕业于震旦大学医学院
English translation: Born in Shanghai; graduated from Aurora University's School of Medicine.

Chinese: 首创全反式维甲酸诱导分化疗法
English translation: Pioneered all-trans retinoic acid therapy to induce cell differentiation.

Chinese: 获国家最高科学技术奖
English translation: Received China's State Preeminent Science and Technology Award.

Chinese: 百岁之年获授“共和国勋章”
English translation: Awarded the Medal of the Republic at the age of 100.

Chinese: 王振义 | 主要贡献
English translation: Wang Zhenyi | Major Contributions

Chinese: 开创“让癌细胞改邪归正”的治疗思路，首创全反式维甲酸疗法。
English translation: Pioneered a treatment that helped cancer cells change course, creating all-trans retinoic acid therapy.

Chinese: 攻克白血病
English translation: Conquered leukemia

Chinese: 使最凶险的急性早幼粒细胞白血病成为可治愈疾病。
English translation: He helped make acute promyelocytic leukemia, once highly fatal, a curable disease.

Chinese: 放弃专利
English translation: Waived patent rights

Chinese: 主动放弃药物专利，让廉价救命药惠及全球患者。
English translation: He gave up patent rights so affordable life-saving medicine could reach patients worldwide.

Chinese: 一门四院士
English translation: Four academicians in one family

Chinese: 言传身教培养大批医学人才，成就“一门四院士”佳话。
English translation: His teaching and example nurtured many medical professionals and led to a family of four academicians.

Chinese: 王振义 | 代表事迹
English translation: Wang Zhenyi | Notable Stories

Chinese: 首例治愈
English translation: First patient cured

Chinese: 应用全反式维甲酸，成功救治首例急性早幼粒细胞白血病患者。
English translation: All-trans retinoic acid was used to successfully treat the first patient with acute promyelocytic leukemia.

Chinese: 方案推广
English translation: Treatment adopted nationwide

Chinese: 治疗方案在全国推广，患者五年生存率大幅提升。
English translation: The treatment spread nationwide, dramatically improving patients' five-year survival rates.

Chinese: 最高科技奖
English translation: Top science and technology award

Chinese: 获国家最高科学技术奖，并把奖金全部捐出。
English translation: He received China's top science and technology award and donated the entire prize.

Chinese: 小麦育种专家 · “中国小麦远缘杂交之父”
English translation: Wheat breeder · “Father of distant hybridization in Chinese wheat”

Chinese: 把野草的基因请进麦田，为中国人多打了一季粮食。
English translation: He brought genes from wild grasses into wheat, helping China harvest more grain.

Chinese: 李振声 | 生平
English translation: Li Zhensheng | Biography

Chinese: 远缘杂交
English translation: Distant hybridization

Chinese: 生于山东淄博，毕业于山东农学院
English translation: Born in Zibo, Shandong; graduated from Shandong Agricultural College.

Chinese: 赴陕西杨凌，开始小麦与偃麦草远缘杂交研究
English translation: Moved to Yangling, Shaanxi, to study distant crosses between wheat and tall wheatgrass.

Chinese: “小偃”系列小麦品种大面积推广
English translation: Xiaoyan wheat varieties were widely adopted.

Chinese: 获授“共和国勋章”
English translation: Awarded the Medal of the Republic.

Chinese: 李振声 | 主要贡献
English translation: Li Zhensheng | Major Contributions

Chinese: 开创远缘杂交
English translation: Pioneered distant hybridization

Chinese: 开创小麦与偃麦草远缘杂交新领域，丰富小麦育种理论。
English translation: Opened a new field in wheat–tall wheatgrass hybridization and enriched wheat-breeding theory.

Chinese: 培育新品种
English translation: Developed new varieties

Chinese: 培育“小偃”系列抗病高产优质品种，累计推广数亿亩。
English translation: Developed disease-resistant, high-yield, high-quality Xiaoyan varieties adopted across vast areas.

Chinese: 染色体工程
English translation: Chromosome engineering

Chinese: 系统研究小麦染色体工程，建立相关技术体系。
English translation: Systematically studied wheat chromosome engineering and established a related technical framework.

Chinese: 中低产田治理
English translation: Improved low- and medium-yield fields

Chinese: 提出黄淮海平原中低产田治理建议，推动粮食大幅增产。
English translation: Proposed ways to improve fields in the Huang-Huai-Hai Plain, helping raise grain output.

Chinese: 李振声 | 代表事迹
English translation: Li Zhensheng | Notable Stories

Chinese: 小偃六号
English translation: Xiaoyan No. 6

Chinese: “小偃六号”等品种大面积推广，成为北方麦区主栽品种。
English translation: Xiaoyan No. 6 and other varieties became widely planted staples in northern wheat-growing regions.

Chinese: 黄淮海会战
English translation: Huang-Huai-Hai campaign

Chinese: 牵头提出中低产田综合治理方案，带动区域粮食增产。
English translation: He led a comprehensive plan to improve low-yield farmland, boosting regional grain production.

Chinese: 获国家最高科学技术奖，成为小麦育种领域代表科学家。
English translation: He received China's top science and technology award and became a leading figure in wheat breeding.

Chinese: 战斗英雄 · 共和国勋章获得者
English translation: Combat hero · Medal of the Republic recipient

Chinese: 从战火中走来，把军功藏进皱纹，把忠诚写在阵地。
English translation: Forged in war, he kept his service medals out of sight and his loyalty on the battlefield.

Chinese: 黄宗德 | 生平
English translation: Huang Zongde | Biography

Chinese: 二级战斗英雄
English translation: Second-Class Combat Hero

Chinese: 生于山东荣成，少年投身革命
English translation: Born in Rongcheng, Shandong; joined the revolution as a young man.

Chinese: 参加革命，同年加入中国共产党
English translation: Joined the revolution and the Communist Party of China in the same year.

Chinese: 抗美援朝金城战役中英勇作战
English translation: Fought bravely in the Battle of Kumsong during the Korean War.

Chinese: 黄宗德 | 主要贡献
English translation: Huang Zongde | Major Contributions

Chinese: 战场立功
English translation: Distinguished service in battle

Chinese: 在解放战争与抗美援朝战争中英勇作战，多次荣立战功。
English translation: He fought bravely in the War of Liberation and the Korean War, earning multiple military honors.

Chinese: 金城鏖战
English translation: Battle of Kumsong

Chinese: 金城战役中带领全班坚守阵地，获“二级战斗英雄”称号。
English translation: He led his squad in holding its position at Kumsong and received the title “Second-Class Combat Hero.”

Chinese: 传承基因
English translation: Carried the legacy forward

Chinese: 离休后关心国防教育，把红色故事讲给青年一代。
English translation: After retirement, he supported national defense education and shared stories of the revolution with young people.

Chinese: 始终保持革命军人作风，是新时代军人的光辉榜样。
English translation: He exemplified the traditions of a revolutionary soldier and remains a role model for today's service members.

Chinese: 黄宗德 | 代表事迹
English translation: Huang Zongde | Notable Stories

Chinese: 金城战役
English translation: Battle of Kumsong

Chinese: 带领全班坚守阵地，面对敌军反扑沉着应战，寸土未失。
English translation: He led his squad in a steady defense against counterattacks and held every inch of ground.

Chinese: 二级英雄
English translation: Second-Class Hero

Chinese: 因战功卓著被授予“二级战斗英雄”荣誉称号。
English translation: For outstanding service, he received the honorary title “Second-Class Combat Hero.”

Chinese: 获授共和国勋章，代表参战将士接受国家致敬。
English translation: Awarded the Medal of the Republic in tribute to the service members who fought in the war.
